categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Silicon Industry Group Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of semiconductor silicon wafers. Its product portfolio includes 300mm polished and epitaxial wafers, 200mm and smaller polished and epitaxial wafers, SOI wafers, and piezoelectric thin film substrate materials. These products serve various semiconductor applications such as memory chips, image sensors, general processors, power devices, sensors, RF chips, analog chips, and discrete devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has mastered multiple core technologies including Czochralski and magnetic field Czochralski single crystal growth, thermal field simulation and design, large-diameter silicon ingot slicing, high-precision rounding, low-stress wire cutting, chemical etching, double-sided grinding, edge grinding, double-sided and single-sided polishing, wafer cleaning, epitaxy, and SOI wafer fabrication technologies. It has overcome key bottlenecks in near-perfect 300mm single crystal growth and ultra-flat polishing, establishing an internationally advanced 300mm silicon material characterization system.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global semiconductor manufacturers such as TSMC, UMC, GlobalFoundries, STMicroelectronics, TowerJazz, and major domestic chip manufacturers like SMIC, Hua Hong Semiconductor, Huahong Microelectronics, and China Resources Microelectronics. The company serves markets across North America, Europe, China, and other Asian countries, supplying wafers for logic, memory, and image sensor applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with major production facilities in Shanghai and expanding capacity in Taiyuan. It also has subsidiaries in Finland (Okmetic) and sales/support teams in Europe, North America, Japan, and Hong Kong, reflecting a global operational footprint aligned with the semiconductor industry's international nature.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Silicon Industry Group operates upstream in the semiconductor supply chain as a key supplier of semiconductor-grade silicon wafers, which are critical raw materials for downstream semiconductor chip manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on expanding production capacity, enriching product structure, and increasing market share. It emphasizes R&D in advanced 300mm wafers, SOI wafers, epitaxial wafers, and piezoelectric thin film substrates, targeting applications in automotive electronics, RF, silicon photonics, and filters. It pursues a 'one-stop' silicon material service strategy, combining self-innovation, external cooperation, and ecosystem building to enhance technological capabilities and domestic supply security.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of semiconductor silicon wafers and related products to downstream chip manufacturers. The company also provides entrusted processing services, with all sales conducted mainly via direct sales channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The global semiconductor silicon wafer industry is oligopolistic, dominated by five major players: Shin-Etsu Chemical, SUMCO, GlobalWafers, Siltronic, and SK Siltron, controlling about 90% of the market. Shanghai Silicon Industry Group positions itself as a leading domestic player aiming to close the technology and market gap with these global leaders through capacity expansion and technological innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 3.19 billion, a decrease of 11.39% from 2022, with net profit attributable to shareholders at RMB 186.54 million, down 42.61%. Total assets grew 14.02% to RMB 29.03 billion, and net assets increased 5.76% to RMB 15.11 billion. The company continues to invest heavily in capacity expansion and R&D, with R&D expenses accounting for 6.96% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive technology portfolio, including advanced 300mm wafer production and SOI wafer capabilities, enabling it to offer a broad product range covering multiple wafer sizes and types. Its strong R&D and innovation capacity, coupled with a globalized operational and sales network, allows it to rapidly respond to customer needs and deliver high-quality, customized silicon wafer solutions, supporting domestic semiconductor industry self-reliance and international competitiveness.
